blocks.md: To find a place on the globe we use a network of imaginary lines. **Parallels of latitude** are circles round the Earth parallel to the Equator. The Equator is **0°**; the poles are **90° N** and **90° S**. **Meridians of longitude** are half-circles from pole to pole. The **Prime Meridian** (0°) passes through Greenwich, London. Longitude is measured east or west of it, up to **180°**.

items.text: Longitude lines run pole to pole

blocks.title: Latitude and longitude
blocks.md: **Latitude** is the angle north or south of the Equator. **Longitude** is the angle east or west of the Prime Meridian. A position is written with latitude first, then longitude, for example **4° N, 9° E**. Cameroon lies roughly between **2° N and 13° N** and between **8° E and 16° E**.

blocks.title: Time and longitude
blocks.md: The Earth turns 360° in 24 hours, so it turns **15° in one hour** (360 ÷ 24), or **1° in 4 minutes**. Places to the **east** have the Sun earlier, so their time is **ahead**; places to the west are **behind**. Time difference (hours) = difference in longitude ÷ 15.

**Local time** is set by the Sun: it is noon when the Sun is highest. Because local time changes from place to place, countries use **standard time**, based on a chosen meridian. The world is divided into **time zones**, about 15° wide. Cameroon uses one standard time for the whole country, which is one hour ahead of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT).

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Latitude (parallels) measures north–south; longitude (meridians) measures east–west.
- Going east, add time; going west, subtract time.
- Do not multiply by 15 when you should divide: 30° of longitude is 30 ÷ 15 = 2 hours, not 450 hours.

blocks.title: Example 1: time difference
blocks.statement: Town A is at 0° and town B is at 45° E. When it is 12 noon at A, what is the time at B?
steps: B is east, so it is ahead: 12:00 + 3 h = 15:00.

blocks.title: Example 2: going west
blocks.statement: A place is at 30° W. When it is 10 a.m. at the Prime Meridian, what is the time there?
